scope: Ranking of next controlled PPO experiments from frozen evidence. No training, no evaluation, no checkpoint or source mutation, no D3/student/B/E/qualification.

selection_rule.metric: mean alive raw frames on the 64 registered development seeds, deterministic argmax
selection_rule.replacement: only a comparable completed audited evaluation with strictly higher dev mean replaces retained best 180
selection_rule.no_regression_continuation: never continue from a worse latest checkpoint; restore retained best model and optimizer with unchanged identity validation

control.description: Unchanged registered PPO config from best180, 72 updates. Existing run D2-continuation-20261025-r2 is one training-seed sample: dev mean alive 1604.08 at update 252.
control.required_second_training_seed: Run once more with an unchanged config and a different registered run_seed to estimate training-seed noise. Required before any arm is read as positive.

measurement_basis.primary: paired mean alive raw frames on the 64 registered D dev seeds, argmax, same seed order
measurement_basis.score_role: reported only; not a pass/fail criterion

statistical_scope.note: SE derived from the published 95% CI [-691.5, +176.4] for 252-180 (CI half-width/1.96). Bootstrap resamples dev seeds conditional on one checkpoint pair. It is not training-seed uncertainty. Effects smaller than about 600 frames cannot be resolved on 64 seeds with one training seed per arm.
statistical_scope.retained_best_selection_bias: Selecting the best dev mean repeatedly on the same 64 seeds is optimistic. Dev curves are selection records, not generalization evidence.

ranking.title: Lower Adam learning rate 3e-4 to 1e-4 (trust-region control)
ranking.single_variable_change: ppo.learning_rate 0.0003 -> 0.0001. Everything else identical, including target_kl 0.03, clip_coef 0.2, ent_coef 0.01, max_grad_norm 0.5, adam_eps 1e-5, reward_scale 0.1, gamma 0.995, lambda 0.95, epochs 4, minibatch 512, rollout_steps 256, 64 envs.
source_hook: python/dodge_rl/train_teacher.py:76 make_optimizer reads ppo.learning_rate for a fresh Adam.

python/dodge_rl/train_teacher.py:169 restore_learner then calls optimizer.load_state_dict, which restores the saved param_groups lr (3e-4). A config-only change is silently overridden on continuation. Verified with torch 2.14.1 on a 2-parameter linear model: fresh lr 1e-4 became 3e-4 after load_state_dict.

Required fix: after restore, set every param_group['lr'] to config ppo.learning_rate, keep restored Adam moments, and assert the effective lr in the receipt. Add a CPU unit test that the resumed lr equals config while exp_avg and exp_avg_sq equal the parent's.
ranking.expected_mechanism: Measured per-update policy movement is near or above the trust-region limit: epoch-end approx_kl about 0.028-0.032 against target_kl 0.03, clip_fraction 0.20-0.23 in every 8-update bin, early-stop flag true in 25-100% of updates per 8-update bin (median about 60%). A smaller step should cut clip fraction and KL-limited epochs and reduce overshoot between dev-evaluated checkpoints. Under Adam, step size is mostly set by lr, so this is the main lever. KL scales roughly with lr squared for small steps, so 1e-4 should cut epoch KL several-fold. The receipt must show the actual contraction.
falsifying_measurement: Integrity gate fails if effective lr != 1e-4 at resume, or if epoch-end KL and clip fraction do not drop. Then the arm is invalid, not negative.
Arm is not positive if paired dev mean alive minus C0 has bootstrap CI crossing zero, or if the difference is inside the training-seed noise floor measured by the second C0 seed.
Hypothesis falsified if clip fraction and KL fall as intended and dev mean alive does not exceed C0 beyond the noise floor. Then trust-region overshoot is not the limit.
Slower-learning signal: dev mean alive falls below C0 band. Trust region may be too tight at this budget.
ranking.budget: 72 updates, 1,179,648 decisions, about 4.71M raw frames, matched to C0. Expected wall about 1165 s training plus evaluation, under the 1800 s total cap and the 1600 s work cap in the D2 registration limits. Peak RSS and MPS driver must stay below 6 GiB (6442450944 bytes). C0 observed 1.92 GB RSS and 2.45 GB MPS.
ranking.seed_scheme: Dev seeds fixed: the 64 registered D seeds, one per independent B1 env, argmax, unchanged order. Training run_seed from the registered continuation config, the same for A and C0 seed 1. Second arm pair uses one new registered run_seed for both A and C0 seed 2. Excluded seed ranges unchanged: [2952790016, 2952791015], [3489660928, 3489661055], [3758096384, 3758097383]. Trajectories diverge once lr differs, so pairing is at the seed-stream level, not per step.
safety_integrity_gates: Parent best180 checkpoint and optimizer state hashed before and after; not written to.
Identity hash, config hash and protocol hash validated as in D2 continuation.
No eval-seed or reserved seed entered training (existing _audit_episode checks).
Effective lr asserted at restore and logged.
Only audited, complete, comparable dev evaluations may be compared.
ranking.retained_best_survival: Candidate checkpoint written only under a new run directory. It replaces retained best 180 only if its completed audited dev mean alive is strictly above 1854.47. Otherwise 180 and its optimizer remain the parent. A worse arm is never the training parent.
prepare_now: Implement lr override plus unit test in a registered source snapshot, not in the live checkout.
Register config with lr 1e-4 and the same run_seed as C0.

ranking.title: Critic reads detached trunk latent (one-way stop-gradient)
ranking.single_variable_change: Critic head input becomes latent.detach(). Value loss no longer updates trunk. Actor path, lr, and all PPO hyperparameters unchanged.
ranking.source_hook: python/dodge_rl/models/teacher.py:175 values=self.critic_head(latent). Change to critic_head(latent.detach()) behind a registered flag. Add a unit test that value-loss gradients into trunk parameters are exactly zero and actor gradients are unchanged on one minibatch. Global clip scale changes, so log per-group norms.
ranking.expected_mechanism: Tests whether critic gradients into the shared trunk degrade policy features (separate-network literature suggests this in some settings). This is a Dodge-specific ablation. It is not PPG and was not directly tested by the cited sources.
ranking.justification_strength: Weak. Measured gradient cosine averages about 0.02 with sign changes (bins between -0.10 and +0.05). Critic/actor norm ratio about 2%. Critic pre-update EV rose in the 252 window (first 8 to last 8: 0.435 to 0.460). Nothing measured shows interference. This arm tests a hypothesis and is not a fix.
falsifying_measurement: Positive only if dev mean alive beats C0 beyond the noise floor. Then interference is supported in this setting, with the global-clip confound logged.
Null result does not show absence of interference. Within-noise null means the test has no power at this budget.
If dev survival improves but critic EV or value loss collapses, the result is capacity loss plus a different policy. Do not read it as interference removed.
ranking.budget: Same 72 updates and seed scheme as A. Same MPS and memory envelope.
safety_integrity_gates: Same identity, dev, and seed gates as A.
Per-group gradient norms logged, including the clip coefficient.
ranking.retained_best_survival: Same as A. Candidate cannot replace 180 unless dev mean is strictly higher and audited.
prepare_now: Implement flag and isolation test in a snapshot. No live edit now.
ranking.status: ranked_second_conditional; run only after A's result is in, and only if the parent still wants to test interference

control_row.role: Required reference, not a candidate. Second training seed needed for the noise floor. Runs in the same sequential MPS slot.

not_ranked.reason: Policy entropy is 1.72-1.77 against ln(9) = 2.197 (about 80% of max) and falls only 0.01-0.04 over 48-72 updates. No collapse is measured, so no exploration case.
No measured critic-bias evidence that a fixed interpretation supports. Changes confound credit horizon with other effects.
Changes objective scale and critic coefficient. Motivation depends on EV decline, which is not established. Larger source change.
Pre-clip grad norm is about 0.77-0.89 against cap 0.5, so clipping is active. Under Adam, global clipping mostly rescales gradients, so the expected effect is small. Low information per MPS minute.
Later or unranked. Needs separate design, and aliased-state diagnostics for memory.

prepare_now: Write the A config and lr-restore fix as a registered snapshot, with unit test. No live training.
Register C0 seed 2 (same config, new run_seed).
Verify the 64 dev seeds and excluded ranges unchanged against the protocol.
Pre-register decision rule and noise-floor criterion before launch.
evidence_that_would_change_ranking: C0 seed 2 differs from C0 seed 1 by more than the A-C0 gap: training-seed noise dominates. Then A and B need two seeds each, or are not identifiable in this budget.
A's KL and clip fraction do not fall after the lr fix: the integrity gate fails, so the arm is invalid and the mechanism untested.
Parent's H1 fresh-seed evaluation shows the 252 drop is checkpoint-specific: reduces urgency for all PPO changes. Prefer C0 replicate only.

Per-death telemetry or reward-split evidence (H2/H3 in the survival-loss decomposition) points to difficulty state or reward value rather than optimizer behavior: changes priority toward non-optimizer interventions.
A dev-eval repeatability check shows nondeterminism above the noise floor: changes power calculations and the decision rule.
limits: No new web or literature research. Sources are the existing reports only.
Survival-loss decomposition is descriptive and not a causal correction. Its CIs crossing zero do not show noise-only explanation.
Gradient cosine and norm ratio are raw single-probe CPU shadows, not causal measures.
Explained variance is diagnostic only. This plan does not rely on an EV decline.
